summary: Obfuscated remote-agent runtime with WebSocket-driven PTY/shell and out-of-band self-update channel
details: @whalent/agent-core@0.3.282 ships a single 13.8 MB main entry dist/index.cjs that is wholly transformed with obfuscator.io output (rotated string array a0_0x52c5, decoder a0_0x279d, _0xNNNN identifiers, all literals reconstructed at runtime), hiding every network destination and command string from static review. The obfuscated bundle composes WebSocket, node-pty, ssh2, child_process.spawn, and a server listen path, and references loopback ports 3389/5900/5901 — the network-driven interactive-shell shape of a remote-control agent on the installer's host. The package's README additionally states that this runtime is 'replaced by remote daemon upgrades' launched by the sibling @whalent/agent wrapper, meaning the code executed on the installer after install can be swapped out-of-band by the maintainer without going through npm; the specific version pinned or reviewed at install time is not what continues to run. The combination of a remote-driven PTY/shell surface, full-bundle obfuscation defeating any behavior audit, and a self-declared post-install code-replacement channel constitutes a persistent remote-access backdoor into the installer's host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
